description_en: Obtains or downloads the logs of a node for a task. The logs are from the stdout and stderr of the system and user scripts
description_zh: 获取（或者下载）任务某个节点的日志，日志来源于系统和用户脚本的stdout和stderr
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dlc get-pod-logs --job-id dlc-20210126170216-00000 --pod-id dlc-20210126170216-00000-chief-0 --pod-uid fe846462-af2c-4521-bd6f-96787a570000 --max-lines 100 --start-time 2020-11-08T16:00:00Z --end-time 2020-11-08T17:00:00Z --download-to-file true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPodLogs

parameters.help_en: The job ID. For more information about how to obtain a job ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459676.html
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The node ID. For more information about how to obtain a node ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459677.html
parameters.name: pod_id

parameters.help_en: The node UID. For more information about how to obtain a node UID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459677.html
parameters.name: pod_uid

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of log entries. Default value: 2000
parameters.help_zh: 返回的日志的最大行数，默认值：2000
parameters.name: max_lines

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Default value: 7 days ago
parameters.help_zh: 查询的起始时间，默认值：7天前
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Default value: current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的截止时间，默认值：当前
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to download the log file. Default value: false. Valid values:

false
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否下载日志文件。取值如下：
false（默认）：表示不下载日志文件。
true：开始下载日志文件
parameters.name: download_to_file
